correctness.rationale: The 61-action preserves F, all nonidentity group elements fix exactly five coordinate points, and chart derivatives give the tangent representation (8,19,33) times unit scalars. The age formula is exhaustively evaluated over all 60 residues. The Picard group of U is Z, its units are C*, free torsor descent gives Pic(V)=Z plus Z/61, and restriction identifies Cl(Y) with Pic(V). All five inertia fibers have weights b-ma_j, so the Cartier kernel is 61Z and the global-to-local map has rank two. Adjunction, finite quotients in codimension one and topological Lefschetz yield the volume and rational Betti values. Standalone code checks finite steps, while geometric theorems are invoked with their hypotheses.

These imply the cohomological corollary and are credited. They do not state or imply without additional fixed-point, descent and local-class analysis the exact local quotient singularities together with the global divisor class image in five local class groups. Published research-record searches yielded only different quotient examples; priority remains provisional.

value.rationale: Quotients by the maximal-prime symmetry of a canonical smooth Fano threefold are natural objects of algebraic-geometry classification. The exact basket, noncanonical discrepancy, and complete rank-two local-to-global Weil/Cartier obstruction across five singular points are intrinsic structural invariants, not an arbitrarily chosen sample. They specify which local Weil divisors globalize and give the Q-Fano canonical index and volume. The novelty claim rests on this classification rather than the previously known middle-cohomology representation.
